files.notes: Settings is a JSON object (Map<String,Value>) so unknown keys, absent-vs-null and key order stay observable; 137 TS members mapped 1:1. Private local stand-ins until other slices land: CONFIG_DIR_NAME/getAgentDir/expandTildePath (config.ts, slice ca-root), JSON.stringify/parse, and the proper-lockfile <file>.lock protocol (utils/dir-lock). Writes use crate::utils::atomic_file::write_file_atomic_sync (slice ca-utils, already landed). enqueueWrite persists eagerly in TS; this port queues and runs writes in flush()/reload() with the same order and the same error-to-recordError behaviour. Verified: 52 tests pass in an isolated parse crate.
session_usage_summary_from, empty_usage, add_assistant_usage, subtract_assistant_usage, clone_usage. Uses pi_ai::types::Usage. Zero-summary returns None (= undefined).

TS swaps process.stdout.write for a stderr-forwarding writer; Rust has no writable global stdout, so the takeover is a process-global flag plus write_stdout (guarded) and write_raw_stdout (raw). is_stdout_taken_over/restore_stdout/flush_raw_stdout match. Call sites (main.ts, acp-mode, rpc-mode, print-mode) are other slices.

create_source_info/create_synthetic_source_info with defaults scope=temporary, origin=top-level. PathMetadata is defined locally (package-manager.ts is slice mega-package-manager) and should become a re-export once that lands.
reset_timings/time/print_timings with PI_TIMING=1 gate, module state behind a Mutex, debug log via pi_ai::log::get_logger plus the same stderr block.

set_log_context/install_file_log_sink with pid first then caller fields, sink merging { ...entry, ...context } (context wins) and 20MiB rotating JSONL append. Private local stand-ins for config.ts getAgentLogPath/appendRotatingLog until slice ca-root lands.
ResourceCollision/ResourceDiagnostic serde structs with camelCase renames and skip_serializing_if for optional keys.
RlmMaxDepthStatus/SetRlmMaxDepthResult with camelCase wire names and omitted globalError when absent.
THINKING_LEVELS = off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max (7 entries, includes off).
